components.name: Button
components.summary: Triggers an action.

components.name: Select
components.summary: Native with a visible label, styled with border-strong on surface.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line input.

components.name: PriorityBadge
components.summary: Ticket priority, as decided by policy (never by the model).

components.name: OutcomeBadge
components.summary: Outcome of a tool call (ok | rejected | error) or a run (completed | failed).

components.name: ReviewBadge
components.summary: Marks a ticket or run that was sent to a person at the agency. review on review-soft, person icon.

components.name: TicketStatus
components.summary: Lifecycle of a ticket: open | in_progress | resolved | cancelled.

components.name: ChatBubble
components.summary: One message in the conversation.

components.name: ChatLog
components.summary: The conversation container: role="log", aria-live="polite", auto-scrolls to the latest message.

components.name: EmergencyNotice
components.summary: Safety guidance attached under the assistant reply that confirms an emergency.

components.name: Composer
components.summary: Message input.

components.name: TicketCard
components.summary: One ticket in "Your tickets".

components.name: TicketList
components.summary: List of TicketCards with aria-label="Your tickets".

components.name: TenantSwitcher
components.summary: Simulated sign-in for the prototype: "Signed in as (simulated)" select + secondary "Switch tenant" button.

components.name: PipelineStages
components.summary: Where a tool call stopped in the executor: validate → authorize → policy → idempotency → execute.

components.name: JsonBlock
components.summary: Readable, syntax-tinted JSON (2-space indent) in mono on subtle.

components.name: TimelineEvent
components.summary: One event in a run's vertical timeline, as a disclosure ( ).

components.name: RunsTable
components.summary: Dense list of agent runs: time, workflow, tenant, agency, status, steps, duration, tokens, cost (£, 4 dp), source (portal / eval).

components.name: PassRate
components.summary: Eval case result: one pip per scored run, n/m, and infra errors as dashed empty pips outside the score ("+ 1 infra error, not scored").

components.name: Icon
components.summary: Inline SVG icons on a 24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps, currentColor, always aria-hidden (the adjacent word carries meaning).

components.name: AgentInspector
components.summary: Agent Inspector: runs table above; selected run run_7f3a2c below with its timeline.

components.name: EvalsReport
components.summary: Evals report: per-case pass rate over 3 runs, infra errors shown separately and not scored, and an expandable expected-vs-actual trace for the failing case.

components.name: TenantPortal
components.summary: Tenant Portal, desktop.

components.name: TenantPortalMobile
components.summary: Tenant Portal at mobile width: same composition stacked (chat first, then tickets) via a container query at 880px.
